READY NOW is threshold-based, not quota-based: score ≥84, at least two primary sources, governed real-asset feasibility, no high dynamic/legal flag, and no unapproved programmatic dependency. Its count is whatever passes those gates.

## Gate

Employee 7 may submit a bounded proposal batch. The central editor chooses approve / merge / evidence-needed / reject. Only an approved topic can receive a formal execution Issue, and total units must include unfinished work already occupying each employee's capacity.
